note.question: How does a parallel machines scheduling game shape the basic core?
note.overview: The model considers the parallel machine scheduling (PMS) under job-splitting game defined by a set of manufacturers where each holds uniform parallel machines and each is committed to produce some jobs submitted to her by her clients while bearing the cost of the sum of completion times of her jobs on her machines. An efficient algorithm for this scheduling problem is well known. The model considers the corresponding cooperative game, where the manufacturers are players that want to join forces.
